gloss: ordinary savings account; regular deposit account

definitions.gloss: ordinary savings account; regular deposit account
definitions.explanation: The most common type of bank account in Japan, allowing deposits and withdrawals at any time. Equivalent to a basic checking/savings account in English-speaking countries.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}の{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}く。
examples.english: To open an ordinary savings account.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: The salary is deposited into the ordinary savings account.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}の{金利|きんり}は{今|いま}とても{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: The interest rate on ordinary savings accounts is very low right now.

notes:
The standard, most common type of bank account in Japan. When opening a bank account, this is typically the default choice. Money can be deposited and withdrawn freely, and it serves as the destination for salary payments, utility bill debits, and everyday transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}: ordinary savings account (the full formal term)
- {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}の{残高|ざんだか}: savings account balance
- {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}の{通帳|つうちょう}: savings account passbook

RELATED ACCOUNT TYPES:
- {定期|ていき}{預金|よきん}: fixed-term deposit — money is locked for a set period in exchange for higher interest
- {当座|とうざ}{預金|よきん}: current account / checking account — used mainly by businesses, does not earn interest
- {貯蓄|ちょちく}{預金|よきん}: savings deposit — a higher-interest account with minimum balance requirements
